# Simplicio Fast LLM guide

Canonical instructions: AGENTS.md
Claude mirror: CLAUDE.md
Gemini mirror: GEMINI.md
Command and feature index: docs/CLI_COMMANDS.md

Identity
--------
`simplicio-fast` turns a repository into a versioned binary/mmap semantic
snapshot, bounded hash-verified context, PlanDAGs, guarded changesets and
workspace/rollout receipts. It is not an LLM, scheduler, policy authority or
source-of-truth database.

Public commands
---------------
`simplicio-fast --help` lists snapshot, query, context, navigation, plan,
delivery, changeset, workspace, scoring, capability, rollout and service
commands. `simplicio-fast-cross-repo --help` lists stack-lock validation.
Every command and nested action has `--help`; consult it before execution.

Safety
------
Use `--json` for automation, preserve versioned schemas, reject unknown major
versions, keep apply/delivery dry-run unless explicitly authorized, and use
Mapper for extraction, Dev CLI for source mutation, Runtime for effects and
Loop for convergence. GitHub issue bodies contain objective plus Execution
for implementation/deployment and tests, without Acceptance Criteria sections.
